content.name: EOC - Executive Operations Center
content.description:
# EOC - Executive Operations Center
# EOC 3.8 GA - Build 324
Novice Operations and Supply Storytelling.
- Preserves the accepted WAITING FOR TRADE CYCLE workflow. - Translates hourly rates, coverage, shortages, surpluses, and snapshot changes into plain player language. - Explains what Supply evidence proves and what ship, buyer, route, and market evidence remains unknown. - Explains why EOC suggests each price or storage setting and what it will change. - Makes Cases command-first and labels retained evidence as supporting context rather than extra tasks. - Keeps advanced evidence available without requiring players to decode it before acting. - Adds no construction, procurement, gameplay watcher, scheduler, cargo, credit, or background gameplay authority.
Compatible with X4 8.x and 9.x.
content.author: RazorEQX
